index.summary: Implement the owner-approved backlog progress and closure conveniences.

product.objective: Let users and agents explain backlog progress and closure through existing XML records while retaining caller-controlled lifecycle decisions.

index.summary: Backlog record/history and optional transition explanations.

deliverable.description: Public progress recording and history reads, optional closure summaries, existing checks and resolving-task links, replay-compatible commands, tests and synchronized guidance.

included.item: Backlog Core/CLI, tests, current documentation and repository Skill.

excluded.item: New schema shapes, mandatory evidence or summaries for closure, automatic acceptance decisions, unrelated backlog research, commits and pushes.

index.summary: Fill the backlog progress and closure explanation gap approved by the owner.

requirement.statement: Add backlog record/records and optional summary/check inputs for lifecycle transitions, reusing existing records/checks/sources and preserving legacy invocation and replay behavior.
requirement.rationale: The owner requested implementation after reviewing the collaboration-oriented command proposal.

acceptance.criterion: Progress notes and history work across lifecycle states, optional closure summaries/checks round-trip, retries do not duplicate entries, legacy calls remain valid, and build/tests pass.

constraints.constraint: History, summaries, evidence and resolving-task links are optional conveniences for closure; recorded check results do not decide lifecycle transitions.
Reuse current XML schemas and preserve fingerprints for legacy transitions without the new optional fields.
